ModMetaData.name: Mugirl Mount Fix
ModMetaData.author: w0bderful
ModMetaData.description:
Prevents Mugirl riders from automatically dismounting solely because of minor injuries.
Defaults: riders may remain mounted when overall health is above 80%, bleeding is at most 5% per day, and pain is below 30%, provided no other medical cause requires dismounting. The correction and each threshold are configurable.
Only the medical-rest check in Mugirl's automatic dismount decision is replaced. Manual dismounting, other automatic or emergency reasons, labor, immunity-related medical needs, surgery, and other tendable conditions retain their original handling. Actual damage, healing, and medical needs are unchanged.
Settings: Options > Mod settings > Mugirl Mount Fix. Load after Harmony and Mugirl Race.
